children: may retest a support at $82.81 per barrel, a break below which could open the way toward $80.38-$81.37 range.
The bounce triggered by the support is classified as a pullback toward the neckline of a head-and-shoulders, which suggests a target at $80.38.
Only a break above $85.15 could make this pattern invalid, as such a break could be followed by a rise toward $86.59-$87.48 range.
On the daily chart, the contract may slide toward $67.04, the start of an uptrend, as it has broken below the support zone of $83.41-$84.35.
A realistic target range is from $77.04 to $78.18, formed by the 76.4% retracement of the uptrend from $66.75 and the 61.8% projection level of a wave C from $110.48.
